stories.title: RBI flags inflation risks from West Asia conflict, El Nino
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India warned that inflationary pressures could rise because of the conflict in West Asia and the expected El Nino weather pattern, and it noted that the Indian economy remains resilient. The RBI’s comment was issued without additional detail on the magnitude or timing of any impact.

stories.title: White House says Melania Trump helped broker Oleshky ceasefire
stories.summary: The White House said US First Lady Melania Trump secured a localized cease‑fire between Russian and Ukrainian forces in the occupied city of Oleshky, with the truce slated to start on 29 October. Both sides confirmed the agreement would allow evacuation of civilians and delivery of aid, and Moscow announced its troops would cease fire at 04:00 (02:00 GMT) on 27 October. Oleshky has been under Russian control since February 2022 and has faced severe shortages of food, medicine and water.
stories.why: The truce could enable evacuation of residents and delivery of humanitarian assistance to a city in acute crisis.

stories.title: Denmark to ban mink farming in government U-turn
stories.summary: Mink farming will end in Denmark by August 2029 after the government decided to drop plans to pursue an exemption to an EU-wide ban on the practice. Denmark was once the largest producer of mink fur in the world, but the industry has declined due to global bans on fur farming, a decline in the fur trade and an earlier outbreak of a Covid strain in the nation's mink population.
